'''Hyper-dejarik''' was a variant of the popular [[Hologame/Legends|hologame]] [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]]. It was played at frantic, breakneck speed. Hyper-dejarik was played at the [[The Grinder Dance Hall|Grinder Dance Hall]] in [[Corestrike]] on [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]] alongside [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and [[sanchango]].<ref name="HNNA">{{JournalCite|12|Heroes Need Not Apply}}</ref>
